description: cfo-api is a Python wrapper for California Forest Observatory data on wildfire-relevant vegetation, weather, topography and infrastructure. Its README documents searching assets by geography, metric and year, then obtaining a download or WMS link. Users supply a county or other area and requested metric; outputs are source asset identifiers and access URLs. Geographic coverage is California. The README states MIT licensing for the wrapper and explicitly warns that Observatory dataset terms are separate. A limitation is that a retrieved canopy or fuel layer may be dated or use a resolution unsuitable for a particular line or road corridor. The client can prepare forest-fuel and exposure inputs for wildfire simulations. The related QGIS catalogue platform can map the returned layers but does not provide this API wrapper. No Observatory dataset or package was downloaded.
name: California Forest Observatory API client
notes: G7 G7-1967. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability. MIT covers the wrapper; CFO datasets have distinct terms per README.
